name: A Friend in Need
summary: A Friend in Need is an urgent plea for aid from Iverron, a young night elf found suffering from venomous spider bites in Shadowglen. Struck down by the deadly beast Githyiss the Vile, Iverron sends travelers to find Dirania Silvershine before the venom claims him.

sections.title: A Reckless Venture
sections.body: Shadowglen's sprawling canopies shelter all manner of wildlife, but the nearby webbed hollows house far darker threats. Ignoring past warnings, Iverron ventured too close to the local webwood caverns and encountered Githyiss the Vile, a vicious spider whose venom quickly overwhelmed the young elf. Stricken with dizziness and failing strength, he is entirely unable to reach safety on his own.

sections.title: A Call to Aldrassil
sections.body: Desperate for survival, Iverron directs any passerby to race back toward the central tree of Aldrassil and alert Dirania Silvershine. Dirania, accustomed to looking out for him and familiar with the hazards of the glen, represents his only hope of preparing a life-saving antidote before the toxin proves fatal.

aliases: who gives a friend in need
faq.answer: Iverron is a young night elf living in Shadowglen within Teldrassil. He frequently wanders into dangerous places despite the warnings of his companions, which leads to his near-fatal encounter with Githyiss the Vile.
He was bitten by Githyiss the Vile, a notorious, highly poisonous spider lurking inside the spider cave nestled within Shadowglen.

aliases: who to talk to for iverron
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine is a night elf residing at Aldrassil in Shadowglen. She is a close friend and guardian figure to Iverron who knows how to treat venomous injuries.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
aliases: where is a friend in need
faq.answer: The quest takes place entirely within Shadowglen, the sheltered starting vale of the night elves nestled high on the crown of Teldrassil.

faq.q: What happens after reporting Iverron's condition to Dirania?
aliases: what next after a friend in need
faq.answer: Dirania immediately sets to work preparing a remedy, dispatching adventurers across the grove to gather the rare reagents needed to brew an antidote before Iverron succumbs to the poison.

faq.q: Why are there deadly spiders inside Shadowglen?
aliases: why are there spiders in shadowglen
faq.answer: Though Shadowglen is considered a safe haven for young night elves, the corruption spreading across Teldrassil has stirred wild beasts and vermin like the webwood spiders into unusually aggressive, venomous predators.

angles.text: For young kaldorei beginning their training beneath Aldrassil, Iverron's predicament is a stark reminder that even the sheltered boughs of Shadowglen are no longer free from corruption and deadly peril.
Druids learn early on that the imbalance in the local wildlife can strike down the unwary, underscoring the urgent need to understand and counter nature's venoms.
